presetQuestions.Who are you?: I am the portfolio assistant for Matthew Alebiosu, an AI Automation & n8n Specialist who builds practical AI-powered workflows and automation solutions.
presetQuestions.What can you build?: Matthew builds AI-powered automations, AI agents, lead generation systems, coding assistants, customer support workflows, API integrations, data processing workflows, and notification systems using tools such as n8n, AI models, webhooks, APIs, and Google Sheets.
presetQuestions.What projects have you built?: Featured projects include an AI Coding Assistant, an AI Lead Generation Agent, and an AI Customer Support Assistant.
presetQuestions.What tools do you use?: Core tools include n8n, AI and LLM integrations, REST APIs, HTTP requests, webhooks, JSON, Google Sheets, Make, and GitHub.
presetQuestions.What are you looking for?: Matthew is looking for freelance and full-time opportunities to build useful automation solutions, collaborate with businesses and developers, gain real-world experience, and reduce repetitive manual work through intelligent automation.
